properties.name: A hub's address is a view over its members (layer 2 of the cross-design view)
properties.rationale: Decision how-a-session-opens-a-view-over-several-designs settled on (a): the hub's address is the view's address, so the person shares one hub and every ordinary tool runs over all its members. The fan-out lives at the tool layer (not a store-level composite) so each member's own precheck, write unit and crediting run unchanged, and no call ever holds two designs' guards. call_tool's body moved verbatim to call_tool_unshaped so the per-client content shaping is applied once. Built as 169483116 and replayed onto main after #721 (1d). Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.summary: A call on a hub's own design that carries _meta["reflow2/view_graph_ids"] is served over the hub and its members: "<graph_id>:<id>" routes to that member (a write lands there and is the caller's), a read naming no member fans out one design at a time, search_design merges ranked hits, and tools that already name their other design or serve text stay hub-only. Without the key nothing changes.
